summary: Attackers compromised the verified Roaring Kitty X account and used it to promote a newly launched Solana memecoin called RKC on Pump.fun. Coordinated sniper wallets rapidly inflated the token price before large scale selloffs collapsed the market and extracted millions from retail buyers.
user_mistake: purchased a token promoted through a sudden social media endorsement without independent verification
prevention: verify token launches through multiple official channels before buying/avoid trading tokens promoted through unexpected celebrity account activity
